Let \(f_n=\displaystyle\int_0^{\frac\pi2}\left(\sum_{k=1}^n\sin^{k-1}x\right)\left(\sum_{k=1}^n(2k-1)\sin^{k-1}x\right)\cos x\,dx\), \(n\in\mathbb N\). Then \(f_{21}-f_{20}\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: With \(s=\sin x\), \(A=\sum s^{k-1}\): \(\sum(2k-1)s^{k-1}=A+2sA'\), so the integrand is \(\dfrac d{ds}(sA^2)\) and \(f_n=A(1)^2=n^2\).

questions.sol: The bracket is \((1+\cos^2x)(1+\cos x\cos3x)\), unchanged by \(x\to\pi-x\), while \(\dfrac{5^{\cos x}}{1+5^{\cos x}}\) pairs with \(\dfrac1{1+5^{\cos x}}\). So \(I=\tfrac12\displaystyle\int_0^\pi(1+\cos^2x)(1+\cos x\cos3x)dx=\tfrac{13\pi}{16}\).

Let \(f(x)=\min\{[x-1],[x-2],\dots,[x-10]\}\) where \([t]\) denotes the greatest integer \(\le t\). Then \(\displaystyle\int_0^{10}f(x)dx+\int_0^{10}(f(x))^2dx+\int_0^{10}|f(x)|dx\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(f=[x]-10\), taking values \(-10,\dots,-1\) on the unit intervals. The first and third integrals cancel; the second is \(\sum_{j=1}^{10}j^2\).

questions.q: Let \(f\) be a differentiable function satisfying \(f(x)=\dfrac2{\sqrt3}\displaystyle\int_0^{\sqrt3}f\left(\dfrac{\lambda^2x}3\right)d\lambda\), \(x>0\) and \(f(1)=\sqrt3\). If \(y=f(x)\) passes through the point \((\alpha,6)\), then \(\alpha\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: With \(s=\lambda\sqrt{x/3}\): \(\sqrt xf(x)=2\displaystyle\int_0^{\sqrt x}f(s^2)ds\). Differentiating gives \(f'=\dfrac f{2x}\), so \(f=\sqrt{3x}\).

questions.q: If \(\displaystyle\int_0^{\sqrt3}\dfrac{15x^3}{\sqrt{1+x^2+\sqrt{(1+x^2)^3}}}dx=\alpha\sqrt2+\beta\sqrt3\), where \(\alpha,\beta\) are integers, then \(\alpha+\beta\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: Put \(1+x^2=w^2\) (\(w\in[1,2]\)): the integral becomes \(15\displaystyle\int_1^2(w-1)\sqrt{1+w}\,dw\); with \(v=1+w\) this is \(15\left[\tfrac25v^{5/2}-\tfrac43v^{3/2}\right]_2^3=16\sqrt2-6\sqrt3\).

Let \(f(\theta)=\sin\theta+\displaystyle\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}(\sin\theta+t\cos\theta)f(t)dt\). Then the value of \(\left|\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi/2}f(\theta)d\theta\right|\) is ______.
questions.sol: \(f=(1+A)\sin\theta+B\cos\theta\) with \(A=\displaystyle\int f=2B\) and \(B=\displaystyle\int tf=2(1+A)\). So \(A=-\tfrac43\), \(B=-\tfrac23\), and \(\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi/2}f=-\tfrac13-\tfrac23\).

If \(\displaystyle\int_{\beta-\frac83}^{2\alpha-1}\max\left\{\dfrac{9-x^2}{5-x},x\right\}dx=\alpha_1+\alpha_2\log_e\left(\dfrac8{15}\right)\), then \(\alpha_1+\alpha_2\) is equal to ______.
The value of \(b>3\) for which \(12\displaystyle\int_3^b\dfrac1{(x^2-1)(x^2-4)}dx=\log_e\left(\dfrac{49}{40}\right)\), is equal to ______.

The value of the integral \(\dfrac{48}{\pi^4}\displaystyle\int_0^\pi\left(\dfrac{3\pi x^2}2-x^3\right)\dfrac{\sin x}{1+\cos^2x}dx\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: Under \(x\to\pi-x\) the polynomial \(\tfrac{3\pi x^2}2-x^3\) becomes \(\tfrac{\pi^3}2-\left(\tfrac{3\pi x^2}2-x^3\right)\). So \(2I=\tfrac{\pi^3}2\displaystyle\int_0^\pi\dfrac{\sin x}{1+\cos^2x}dx=\tfrac{\pi^4}4\), and \(\tfrac{48}{\pi^4}\cdot\tfrac{\pi^4}8=6\).

If \(\displaystyle\int_0^\pi(\sin^3x)e^{-\sin^2x}dx=\alpha-\dfrac\beta e\int_0^1\sqrt te^tdt\), then \(\alpha+\beta\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: With \(c=\cos x\) and then \(t=c^2\): \(I=\dfrac1e\displaystyle\int_0^1\left(\dfrac1{\sqrt t}-\sqrt t\right)e^tdt\). By parts \(\displaystyle\int_0^1\dfrac{e^t}{\sqrt t}dt=2e-2\int_0^1\sqrt te^tdt\), so \(I=2-\dfrac3e\displaystyle\int_0^1\sqrt te^tdt\).

questions.sol: On \([0,1)\) the bracket is \([-\cos x]=-1\); on \(\left[1,\sqrt{\pi/2}\right)\) it is \([1-\cos x]=0\). The integral is \(-1\).

If \(I_{m,n}=\displaystyle\int_0^1x^{m-1}(1-x)^{n-1}dx\), for \(m,n\ge1\), and \(\displaystyle\int_0^1\frac{x^{m-1}+x^{n-1}}{(1+x)^{m+n}}dx=\alpha I_{m,n}\), \(\alpha\in\mathbb{R}\), then \(\alpha\) equals ______.
questions.sol:
In \(I_{m,n}\) put \(x=\dfrac{t}{1+t}\) (\(dx=\dfrac{dt}{(1+t)^2}\), \(1-x=\dfrac1{1+t}\)): \(I_{m,n}=\displaystyle\int_0^\infty\frac{t^{m-1}}{(1+t)^{m+n}}dt\).
Split \(\displaystyle\int_0^\infty=\int_0^1+\int_1^\infty\) and put \(x\to\frac1x\) in the second part: it becomes \(\displaystyle\int_0^1\frac{x^{n-1}}{(1+x)^{m+n}}dx\).
Hence \(\displaystyle\int_0^1\frac{x^{m-1}+x^{n-1}}{(1+x)^{m+n}}dx=I_{m,n}\), i.e. \(\alpha=1\).

If the area of the region \(\{(x,y):1+x^2\le y\le\min\{x+7,11-3x\}\}\) is \(A\), then \(3A\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(y=1+x^2\) meets \(y=x+7\) at \(x=-2\) and \(y=11-3x\) at \(x=2\); the two lines meet at \(x=1\). \(A=\displaystyle\int_{-2}^1(x+6-x^2)dx+\int_1^2(10-3x-x^2)dx=\tfrac{27}2+\tfrac{19}6=\tfrac{50}3\).

questions.q: Let \(f:\mathbf R\to\mathbf R\) be a twice differentiable function such that \(f(x+y)=f(x)f(y)\) for all \(x,y\in\mathbf R\). If \(f'(0)=4a\) and \(f\) satisfies \(f''(x)-3af'(x)-f(x)=0\), \(a>0\), then the area of the region \(R=\{(x,y)\mid0\le y\le f(ax),0\le x\le2\}\) is :

questions.sol: The lines meet at \((3,9)\); the curve meets \(y=3x\) at \(0\) and \(2y=27-3x\) at \(x=9\). \(A=\displaystyle\int_0^3x^{3/2}dx+\int_3^9\left(\tfrac{27-3x}2-3x+x^{3/2}\right)dx=\tfrac{81}5\).

The area bounded by the curves \(y=|x-1|+|x-2|\) and \(y=3\) is equal to

questions.sol: They meet at \(y_0=\dfrac{2k}{k^2+4}\), and the area is \(\displaystyle\int_0^{y_0}\left(y-\tfrac{ky^2}2-\tfrac{2y^2}k\right)dy=\dfrac{y_0^2}6\), largest when \(|y_0|\) is largest: \(k=\pm2\).

questions.q: Let the area of the region \(\{(x,y):x-2y+4\ge0,\ x+2y^2\ge0,\ x+4y^2\le8,\ y\ge0\}\) be \(\dfrac mn\), where \(m\) and \(n\) are coprime numbers. Then \(m+n\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: For \(y\ge0\): \(x\ge\max\{-2y^2,2y-4\}\) and \(x\le8-4y^2\). The lower bound switches at \(y=1\) (\(-2=-2\)), and the strip closes where \(2y-4=8-4y^2\), i.e. \(y=\tfrac32\). Area \(\displaystyle\int_0^1(8-2y^2)dy+\int_1^{3/2}(12-2y-4y^2)dy=\tfrac{22}3+\tfrac{19}{12}=\tfrac{107}{12}\).

questions.q: If the area of the region \(\{(x,y):0\le y\le\min\{2x,6x-x^2\}\}\) is \(A\), then \(12A\) is equal to ______.

The area (in sq. units) of the part of the circle \(x^2+y^2=169\) which is below the line \(5x-y=13\) is \(\dfrac{\pi\alpha}{2\beta}-\dfrac{65}2+\dfrac\alpha\beta\sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{12}{13}\right)\), where \(\alpha,\beta\) are coprime numbers. Then \(\alpha+\beta\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: The chord joins \((0,-13)\) and \((5,12)\), subtending \(\theta\) with \(\sin\theta=\tfrac5{13}\), \(\cos\theta=-\tfrac{12}{13}\). The required (minor) segment is \(\tfrac{169}2(\theta-\sin\theta)\) with \(\theta=\tfrac\pi2+\sin^{-1}\tfrac{12}{13}\): \(\tfrac{169\pi}4-\tfrac{65}2+\tfrac{169}2\sin^{-1}\tfrac{12}{13}\).

questions.q: Let the area of the region \(\{(x,y):0\le x\le3,\ 0\le y\le\min\{x^2+2,2x+2\}\}\) be \(A\). Then \(12A\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(x^2+2\le2x+2\) on \([0,2]\). \(A=\displaystyle\int_0^2(x^2+2)dx+\int_2^3(2x+2)dx=\tfrac{20}3+7\). (The book prints \(2x+3\); the exam paper has \(2x+2\), which gives the official answer \(164\).)

questions.q: The area of the region enclosed by the parabola \((y-2)^2=x-1\), the line \(x-2y+4=0\) and the positive coordinate axes is ______.
questions.sol: The line is the tangent at \((2,3)\) and meets the \(y\)-axis at \(y=2\). Area \(\displaystyle\int_0^2\left((y-2)^2+1\right)dy+\int_2^3(y-3)^2dy=\tfrac{14}3+\tfrac13\).

questions.q: If the area of region \(S=\{(x,y):2y-y^2\le x^2\le2y,x\ge y\}\) is equal to \(\dfrac{n+2}{n+1}-\dfrac\pi{n-1}\), then the natural number \(n\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: The region lies between the circle \(x^2+(y-1)^2=1\) and the parabola \(x^2=2y\), below \(y=x\); the curves meet \(y=x\) at \((1,1)\) and \((2,2)\). Its area is \(\tfrac76-\tfrac\pi4\).

questions.q: Let the area enclosed by the lines \(x+y=2\), \(y=0\), \(x=0\) and the curve \(f(x)=\min\left\{x^2+\dfrac34,1+[x]\right\}\), where \([x]\) denotes the greatest integer \(\le x\), be \(A\). Then the value of \(12A\) is ______.
questions.sol: The top boundary is \(x^2+\tfrac34\) on \(\left[0,\tfrac12\right]\), \(1\) on \(\left[\tfrac12,1\right]\) and \(2-x\) on \([1,2]\): \(A=\tfrac{19}{24}+\tfrac12+\tfrac12\).

questions.q: Let \(y=p(x)\) be the parabola passing through the points \((-1,0)\), \((0,1)\) and \((1,0)\). If the area of the region \(\{(x,y):(x+1)^2+(y-1)^2\le1,y\le p(x)\}\) is \(A\), then \(12(\pi-4A)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(p=1-x^2\) passes through \((-1,0)\) and \((0,1)\), which are ends of a quarter of the circle. The region is the quarter-disc segment cut by the chord minus the part between the chord \(y=x+1\) and the parabola: \(A=\left(\tfrac\pi4-\tfrac12\right)+\displaystyle\int_{-1}^0(1-x^2-(1+x))dx=\tfrac\pi4-\tfrac12+\tfrac16\). So \(12(\pi-4A)=12\cdot\tfrac43\).

questions.q: If the area of the region \(\{(x,y):|x^2-2|\le y\le x\}\) is \(A\), then \(6A+16\sqrt2\) is equal to ______.
If \(A\) is the area in the first quadrant enclosed by the curve \(C:2x^2-y+1=0\), the tangent to \(C\) at the point \((1,3)\) and the line \(x+y=1\), then the value of \(60A\) is ______.
questions.sol: The tangent \(y=4x-1\) meets \(x+y=1\) at \(\left(\tfrac25,\tfrac35\right)\), and the parabola meets \(x+y=1\) at \((0,1)\). \(A=\displaystyle\int_0^{2/5}(2x^2+x)dx+\int_{2/5}^12(x-1)^2dx=\tfrac{4}{15}\).

questions.q: If the area bounded by the curve \(2y^2=3x\), lines \(x+y=3\), \(y=0\) and outside the circle \((x-3)^2+y^2=2\) is \(A\), then \(4(\pi+4A)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: The region between the parabola, the line and the \(x\)-axis has area \(\displaystyle\int_0^{3/2}\left(3-y-\tfrac{2y^2}3\right)dy=\tfrac{21}8\). The line passes through the circle's centre, cutting off a \(45^\circ\) sector of area \(\tfrac\pi4\) inside the region. \(A=\tfrac{21}8-\tfrac\pi4\).

questions.q: Let \(A\) be the area bounded by the curve \(y=x|x-3|\), the \(x\)-axis and the ordinates \(x=-1\) and \(x=2\). Then \(12A\) is equal to ______.
If the area of the region bounded by the curves \(y^2-2y=-x\), \(x+y=0\) is \(A\), then \(8A\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: In terms of \(y\): \(x=2y-y^2\) and \(x=-y\) meet at \(y=0,3\). \(A=\displaystyle\int_0^3(3y-y^2)dy=\tfrac92\).

questions.q: If the area enclosed by the parabolas \(P_1:2y=5x^2\) and \(P_2:x^2-y+6=0\) is equal to the area enclosed by \(P_1\) and \(y=\alpha x\), \(\alpha>0\), then \(\alpha^3\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(P_1,P_2\) meet at \(x=\pm2\), enclosing \(\displaystyle\int_{-2}^2\left(6-\tfrac32x^2\right)dx=16\). \(P_1\) and \(y=\alpha x\) enclose \(\dfrac{2\alpha^3}{75}\).

questions.q: Let \(\alpha\) be the area of the larger region bounded by the curve \(y^2=8x\) and the lines \(y=x\) and \(x=2\), which lies in the first quadrant. Then the value of \(3\alpha\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: The curve and \(y=x\) meet at \(x=8\); \(x=2\) splits the region into \(\displaystyle\int_0^2(\sqrt{8x}-x)dx=\tfrac{10}3\) and \(\displaystyle\int_2^8(\sqrt{8x}-x)dx=\tfrac{22}3\).

questions.q: Let \(A\) be the area of the region \(\{(x,y):y\ge x^2,\ y\ge(1-x)^2,\ y\le2x(1-x)\}\). Then \(540A\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: The region is symmetric about \(x=\tfrac12\); \(y=2x(1-x)\) meets \(y=(1-x)^2\) at \(x=\tfrac13\). \(A=2\displaystyle\int_{1/3}^{1/2}\left(2x-2x^2-(1-x)^2\right)dx=\tfrac5{108}\).

questions.q: Let for \(x\in R\), \(f(x)=\dfrac{x+|x|}2\) and \(g(x)=\begin{cases}x, & x<0\\x^2, & x\ge0\end{cases}\). Then area bounded by the curve \(y=(fog)(x)\) and the lines \(y=0\), \(2y-x=15\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \((fog)(x)=0\) for \(x<0\) and \(x^2\) for \(x\ge0\). The line \(y=\tfrac{x+15}2\) meets \(y=0\) at \(x=-15\) and \(y=x^2\) at \(x=3\). Area \(\displaystyle\int_{-15}^0\tfrac{x+15}2dx+\int_0^3\left(\tfrac{x+15}2-x^2\right)dx=\tfrac{225}4+\tfrac{63}4\).

questions.q: Let the area of the region \(\{(x,y):|2x-1|\le y\le|x^2-x|,0\le x\le1\}\) be \(A\). Then \((6A+11)^2\) is equal to ______.

Let \(S\) be the region bounded by the curves \(y=x^3\) and \(y^2=x\). The curve \(y=2|x|\) divides \(S\) into two regions of area \(R_1\) and \(R_2\). If \(\max\{R_1,R_2\}=R_2\), then \(\dfrac{R_2}{R_1}\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(S\) lies over \([0,1]\) with area \(\tfrac23-\tfrac14=\tfrac5{12}\). \(y=2x\) meets \(y=\sqrt x\) at \(x=\tfrac14\), cutting off \(R_1=\displaystyle\int_0^{1/4}(\sqrt x-2x)dx=\tfrac1{48}\); \(R_2=\tfrac{19}{48}\).

questions.q: The area (in sq. units) of the region enclosed between the parabola \(y^2=2x\) and the line \(x+y=4\) is ______.
Let \(A_1=\{(x,y):|x|\le y^2,|x|+2y\le8\}\) and \(A_2=\{(x,y):|x|+|y|\le k\}\). If \(27(\text{Area }A_1)=5(\text{Area }A_2)\), then \(k\) is equal to :
questions.sol: Taking the bounded part (\(y\ge0\)): strips of width \(2y^2\) for \(y\in[0,2]\) and \(2(8-2y)\) for \(y\in[2,4]\), so Area \(A_1=\tfrac{16}3+8=\tfrac{40}3\). Area \(A_2=2k^2\), and \(27\cdot\tfrac{40}3=10k^2\).

questions.q: If the area of the region \(\left\{(x,y):x^{\frac23}+y^{\frac23}\le1,x+y\ge0,y\ge0\right\}\) is \(A\), then \(\dfrac{256A}\pi\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: The astroid encloses \(\tfrac{3\pi}8\), i.e. \(\tfrac{3\pi}{32}\) per quadrant. The region is the first-quadrant part plus half of the second-quadrant part (cut by \(y=-x\), a symmetry line): \(A=\tfrac{3\pi}{32}+\tfrac{3\pi}{64}=\tfrac{9\pi}{64}\).

questions.q: For real numbers \(a,b\) \((a>b>0)\), let \(\text{Area}\left\{(x,y):x^2+y^2\le a^2\text{ and }\dfrac{x^2}{a^2}+\dfrac{y^2}{b^2}\ge1\right\}=30\pi\) and \(\text{Area}\left\{(x,y):x^2+y^2\ge b^2\text{ and }\dfrac{x^2}{a^2}+\dfrac{y^2}{b^2}\le1\right\}=18\pi\). Then the value of \((a-b)^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\pi a^2-\pi ab=30\pi\) and \(\pi ab-\pi b^2=18\pi\); subtracting gives \(a^2-2ab+b^2=12\).

questions.q: The area of the region \(S=\{(x,y):3x^2\le4y\le6x+24\}\) is ______.

Let \(a\) and \(b\) respectively be the points of local maximum and local minimum of the function \(f(x)=2x^3-3x^2-12x\). If \(A\) is the total area of the region bounded by \(y=f(x)\), the \(x\)-axis and the lines \(x=a\) and \(x=b\), then \(4A\) is equal to ______.
If the line \(y=mx\) bisects the area enclosed by the lines \(x=0\), \(y=0\), \(x=\dfrac32\) and the curve \(y=1+4x-x^2\), then \(12m\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: The total area is \(\displaystyle\int_0^{3/2}(1+4x-x^2)dx=\tfrac{39}8\); the triangle under \(y=mx\) has area \(\tfrac{9m}8=\tfrac{39}{16}\).

questions.q: Let \(T\) be the tangent to the ellipse \(E:x^2+4y^2=5\) at the point \(P(1,1)\). If the area of the region bounded by tangent \(T\), ellipse \(E\), lines \(x=1\) and \(x=\sqrt5\) is \(\alpha\sqrt5+\beta+\gamma\cos^{-1}\left(\dfrac1{\sqrt5}\right)\), then \(|\alpha+\beta+\gamma|\) is equal to ______.
The area (in sq. units) of the region bounded by the curves \(x^2+2y-1=0\), \(y^2+4x-4=0\) and \(y^2-4x-4=0\), in the upper half plane is ______.
questions.sol: The second and third parabolas meet at \((0,2)\) and cross the \(x\)-axis at \(x=\pm1\), where the first parabola also meets the axis. Area \(\displaystyle\int_0^2\left(2-\tfrac{y^2}2\right)dy-\int_{-1}^1\tfrac{1-x^2}2dx=\tfrac83-\tfrac23\).

questions.q: Let \(f:[-3,1]\to R\) be given as \(f(x)=\begin{cases}\min\{(x+6),x^2\}, & -3\le x\le0\\\max\{\sqrt x,x^2\}, & 0\le x\le1\end{cases}\). If the area bounded by \(y=f(x)\) and \(x\)-axis is \(A\), then the value of \(6A\) is equal to ______.

The graphs of sine and cosine functions, intersect each other at a number of points and between two consecutive points of intersection, the two graphs enclose the same area \(A\). Then \(A^4\) is equal to ______.
The area bounded by the lines \(y=||x-1|-2|\) is ______.
questions.sol: Together with the \(x\)-axis, the graph encloses the triangle \(y=2-|x-1|\) over \([-1,3]\): base \(4\), height \(2\).

questions.q: The value of \(\displaystyle\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}\left(\frac{\pi+4x^{11}}{1-\sin\left(|x|+\frac{\pi}{6}\right)}\right)dx\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
The denominator is even, so the \(4x^{11}\) part is odd and integrates to \(0\):
\[I=2\pi\int_0^{\pi/6}\frac{dx}{1-\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{6}\right)}=2\pi\int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}\frac{du}{1-\sin u}=2\pi\Big[\tan u+\sec u\Big]_{\pi/6}^{\pi/3}.\]
\((\sqrt3+2)-\left(\tfrac1{\sqrt3}+\tfrac2{\sqrt3}\right)=2\), so \(I=4\pi\).

questions.q: The area of the region inside the ellipse \(x^2+4y^2=4\) and outside the region bounded by the curves \(y=|x|-1\) and \(y=1-|x|\) is:
questions.sol:
The ellipse \(\dfrac{x^2}{4}+y^2=1\) has area \(\pi\cdot2\cdot1=2\pi\). The curves \(y=\pm(1-|x|)\) bound the square with vertices \((\pm1,0),(0,\pm1)\), of area \(2\), which lies inside the ellipse.
Required area \(=2\pi-2=2(\pi-1)\).

questions.q: \(6\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi}\left|\sin3x+\sin2x+\sin x\right|dx\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
\(\sin3x+\sin x+\sin2x=\sin2x(2\cos x+1)\): positive on \(\left(0,\tfrac\pi2\right)\), negative on \(\left(\tfrac\pi2,\tfrac{2\pi}3\right)\), positive on \(\left(\tfrac{2\pi}3,\pi\right)\).
With \(F(x)=-\dfrac{\cos3x}{3}-\dfrac{\cos2x}{2}-\cos x\): \(F(0)=-\tfrac{11}{6}\), \(F\left(\tfrac\pi2\right)=\tfrac12\), \(F\left(\tfrac{2\pi}3\right)=\tfrac5{12}\), \(F(\pi)=\tfrac56\).
\(\int_0^\pi|\cdot|=\tfrac73+\tfrac1{12}+\tfrac5{12}=\tfrac{17}{6}\), so the answer is \(17\).

questions.q: If the area of the region \(\{(x,y):1-2x\le y\le4-x^2,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0\}\) is \(\dfrac{\alpha}{\beta}\), \(\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb{N}\), \(\gcd(\alpha,\beta)=1\), then the value of \((\alpha+\beta)\) is:
questions.sol:
The region lies under \(y=4-x^2\) for \(0\le x\le2\), above \(y=0\), with the triangle below \(y=1-2x\) (\(0\le x\le\tfrac12\)) removed:
\[\text{Area}=\int_0^2(4-x^2)\,dx-\int_0^{1/2}(1-2x)\,dx=\frac{16}{3}-\frac14=\frac{61}{12}.\]
\(\alpha+\beta=73\).

questions.q: Let \([\cdot]\) denote the greatest integer function and \(f(x)=\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac1{n^3}\sum_{k=1}^{n}\left[\frac{k^2}{3^x}\right]\). Then \(12\displaystyle\sum_{j=1}^{\infty}f(j)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
\(\dfrac{k^2}{3^x}-1<\left[\dfrac{k^2}{3^x}\right]\le\dfrac{k^2}{3^x}\), and \(\dfrac1{n^3}\displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^n k^2\to\dfrac13\) while \(\dfrac{n}{n^3}\to0\). By sandwich, \(f(x)=\dfrac{1}{3\cdot3^x}\).
\(\displaystyle\sum_{j\ge1}f(j)=\sum_{j\ge1}\frac1{3^{j+1}}=\frac{1/9}{1-1/3}=\frac16\), so \(12\cdot\tfrac16=2\).

questions.q: If \(\displaystyle\int_0^1 4\cot^{-1}(1-2x+4x^2)\,dx=a\tan^{-1}(2)-b\log_e(5)\), where \(a,b\in\mathbb{N}\), then \((2a+b)\) is equal to ______.
Let \(f:[1,\infty)\to\mathbb{R}\) be a differentiable function. If \(6\displaystyle\int_1^x f(t)\,dt=3xf(x)+x^3-4\) for all \(x\ge1\), then the value of \(f(2)-f(3)\) is:
questions.sol:
Differentiating: \(6f=3f+3xf'+3x^2\Rightarrow xf'-f=-x^2\Rightarrow\left(\dfrac fx\right)'=-1\Rightarrow f(x)=-x^2+Cx\).
At \(x=1\): \(0=3f(1)-3\Rightarrow f(1)=1\Rightarrow C=2\). So \(f(x)=2x-x^2\) and \(f(2)-f(3)=0-(-3)=3\).

questions.q: Let the line \(x=-1\) divide the area of the region \(\{(x,y):1+x^2\le y\le3-x\}\) in the ratio \(m:n\), \(\gcd(m,n)=1\). Then \(m+n\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
The curves meet at \(x=-2\) and \(x=1\). With \(F(x)=2x-\dfrac{x^2}{2}-\dfrac{x^3}{3}\) (antiderivative of \(2-x-x^2\)):
Left part \(=F(-1)-F(-2)=-\tfrac{13}{6}+\tfrac{10}{3}=\tfrac76\); right part \(=F(1)-F(-1)=\tfrac76+\tfrac{13}{6}=\tfrac{10}{3}\).
Ratio \(\tfrac76:\tfrac{20}{6}=7:20\), so \(m+n=27\).

questions.q: The value of \(\displaystyle\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}\left(\frac{1}{[x]+4}\right)dx\), where \([\cdot]\) denotes the greatest integer function, is:

If \(\displaystyle\int(\sin x)^{-\frac{11}{2}}(\cos x)^{-\frac52}dx=-\frac{p_1}{q_1}(\cot x)^{\frac92}-\frac{p_2}{q_2}(\cot x)^{\frac52}-\frac{p_3}{q_3}(\cot x)^{\frac12}+\frac{p_4}{q_4}(\cot x)^{-\frac32}+C\), where \(p_i\) and \(q_i\) are positive integers with \(\gcd(p_i,q_i)=1\) for \(i=1,2,3,4\) and \(C\) is the constant of integration, then \(\dfrac{15p_1p_2p_3p_4}{q_1q_2q_3q_4}\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
Integrand \(=(\cot x)^{-5/2}\operatorname{cosec}^8x\). Put \(t=\cot x\), \(dt=-\operatorname{cosec}^2x\,dx\), \(\operatorname{cosec}^6x=(1+t^2)^3\):
\[-\int t^{-5/2}(1+t^2)^3dt=\tfrac23t^{-3/2}-6t^{1/2}-\tfrac65t^{5/2}-\tfrac29t^{9/2}+C.\]
So \(\dfrac{p_1}{q_1}=\tfrac29,\ \dfrac{p_2}{q_2}=\tfrac65,\ \dfrac{p_3}{q_3}=6,\ \dfrac{p_4}{q_4}=\tfrac23\); product \(=\tfrac{16}{15}\), and \(15\cdot\tfrac{16}{15}=16\).

questions.q: The area of the region \(A=\{(x,y):4x^2+y^2\le8\text{ and }y^2\le4x\}\) is:
questions.sol:
The curves meet where \(4x^2+4x=8\), i.e. \(x=1\), \(y=\pm2\). By symmetry about the \(x\)-axis,
\[A=2\left[\int_0^1 2\sqrt x\,dx+\int_1^{\sqrt2}2\sqrt{2-x^2}\,dx\right]=2\left[\frac43+2\left(\frac\pi4-\frac12\right)\right]=\pi+\frac23.\]

questions.q: Let \([\cdot]\) be the greatest integer function. If \(\alpha=\displaystyle\int_0^{64}\left(x^{1/3}-[x^{1/3}]\right)dx\), then \(\dfrac1\pi\displaystyle\int_0^{\alpha\pi}\left(\frac{\sin^2\theta}{\sin^6\theta+\cos^6\theta}\right)d\theta\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
\(\int_0^{64}x^{1/3}dx=192\) and \(\int_0^{64}[x^{1/3}]dx=1\cdot7+2\cdot19+3\cdot37=156\), so \(\alpha=36\).
The integrand has period \(\pi\). On \(\left(0,\tfrac\pi2\right)\), with \(t=\tan\theta\):
\[\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{\sin^2\theta\,d\theta}{\sin^6\theta+\cos^6\theta}=\int_0^\infty\frac{t^2(1+t^2)}{1+t^6}dt=\int_0^\infty\frac{t^2\,dt}{t^4-t^2+1}=\frac\pi2,\]
(the last integral equals the one with \(1\) in the numerator, by \(t\to\tfrac1t\), and their sum is \(\pi\)).
So \(\int_0^\pi=\pi\), and the required value is \(\dfrac{36\pi}{\pi}=36\).

questions.q: The value of the integral \(\displaystyle\int_{\pi/24}^{5\pi/24}\frac{dx}{1+\sqrt[3]{\tan2x}}\) is:
questions.sol:
Replacing \(x\) by \(\tfrac\pi4-x\) (limits add to \(\tfrac\pi4\)) changes \(\tan2x\) to \(\cot2x\), so \(I=\displaystyle\int\frac{\sqrt[3]{\tan2x}}{1+\sqrt[3]{\tan2x}}dx\).
Adding: \(2I=\dfrac{5\pi}{24}-\dfrac{\pi}{24}=\dfrac\pi6\), so \(I=\dfrac\pi{12}\).

questions.q: Let \(f(x)=\displaystyle\int\frac{(2-x^2)\,e^x}{\sqrt{1+x}\,(1-x)^{3/2}}dx\). If \(f(0)=0\), then \(f\left(\dfrac12\right)\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
Let \(g(x)=\sqrt{\dfrac{1+x}{1-x}}\). Then \(g'(x)=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1+x}(1-x)^{3/2}}\) and \(g=\dfrac{1-x^2}{\sqrt{1+x}(1-x)^{3/2}}\), so \(g+g'=\dfrac{2-x^2}{\sqrt{1+x}(1-x)^{3/2}}\).
Hence \(f(x)=e^xg(x)+C\); \(f(0)=0\Rightarrow C=-1\). \(f\left(\tfrac12\right)=\sqrt e\cdot\sqrt3-1=\sqrt{3e}-1\).

questions.q: Let the area of the region bounded by the curve \(y=\max\{\sin x,\cos x\}\), lines \(x=0\), \(x=\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\) and the \(x\)-axis be \(A\). Then \(A+A^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
\(y=\cos x\) on \(\left[0,\tfrac\pi4\right]\), \(\sin x\) on \(\left[\tfrac\pi4,\tfrac{5\pi}4\right]\), \(\cos x\) on \(\left[\tfrac{5\pi}4,\tfrac{3\pi}2\right]\).
\(A=\int_0^{\pi/4}\cos x+\int_{\pi/4}^{\pi}\sin x+\left|\int_\pi^{5\pi/4}\sin x\right|+\left|\int_{5\pi/4}^{3\pi/2}\cos x\right|=\tfrac{\sqrt2}{2}+\left(1+\tfrac{\sqrt2}{2}\right)+\left(1-\tfrac{\sqrt2}{2}\right)+\left(1-\tfrac{\sqrt2}{2}\right)=3\).
\(A+A^2=12\).

questions.q: Let \(I(x)=\displaystyle\int\frac{3\,dx}{(4x+6)\sqrt{4x^2+8x+3}}\) and \(I(0)=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{4}+20\). If \(I\left(\dfrac12\right)=\dfrac{a\sqrt2}{b}+c\), where \(a,b,c\in\mathbb{N}\), \(\gcd(a,b)=1\), then \(a+b+c\) is equal to:
The area of the region enclosed between the circles \(x^2+y^2=4\) and \(x^2+(y-2)^2=4\) is:
questions.sol:
Two circles of radius \(2\) with centres \(2\) apart. Each circle contributes a segment with central angle \(\tfrac{2\pi}{3}\):
\[A=2\left[\frac12\cdot4\cdot\frac{2\pi}{3}-\frac12\cdot4\sin\frac{2\pi}{3}\right]=\frac{8\pi}{3}-2\sqrt3=\frac23(4\pi-3\sqrt3).\]

questions.q: The number of elements in the set \(S=\left\{x:x\in[0,100]\text{ and }\displaystyle\int_0^x t^2\sin(x-t)\,dt=x^2\right\}\) is ______.
questions.sol:
Integrating by parts twice: \(\displaystyle\int_0^x t^2\sin(x-t)\,dt=x^2+2\cos x-2\).
So the condition is \(\cos x=1\), i.e. \(x=2k\pi\). In \([0,100]\): \(k=0,1,\dots,15\) (\(32\pi>100\)). Hence \(16\) elements.

Let \(f(t)=\displaystyle\int\left(\frac{1-\sin(\log_et)}{1-\cos(\log_et)}\right)dt\), \(t>1\). If \(f\left(e^{\pi/2}\right)=-e^{\pi/2}\) and \(f\left(e^{\pi/4}\right)=\alpha e^{\pi/4}\), then \(\alpha\) equals:
questions.sol:
Put \(t=e^u\): \(f=\displaystyle\int e^u\left(\tfrac12\operatorname{cosec}^2\tfrac u2-\cot\tfrac u2\right)du=-e^u\cot\frac u2+C\) (form \(e^u(g+g')\) with \(g=-\cot\tfrac u2\)).

\(\alpha=-1-\sqrt2\).

The value of \(\displaystyle\sum_{r=1}^{20}\left(\sqrt{\pi\left(\int_0^r x|\sin\pi x|\,dx\right)}\right)\) is ______.
questions.sol:
On \([k,k+1]\), \(|\sin\pi x|\) is symmetric about \(k+\tfrac12\), so \(\int_k^{k+1}x|\sin\pi x|\,dx=\left(k+\tfrac12\right)\cdot\tfrac2\pi\).
\(\int_0^rx|\sin\pi x|\,dx=\tfrac2\pi\sum_{k=0}^{r-1}\left(k+\tfrac12\right)=\tfrac{r^2}{\pi}\), so each term is \(r\). Sum \(=\sum_{r=1}^{20}r=210\).

questions.q: Let \(P_1:y=4x^2\) and \(P_2:y=x^2+27\) be two parabolas. If the area of the bounded region enclosed between \(P_1\) and \(P_2\) is six times the area of the bounded region enclosed between the line \(y=\alpha x\), \(\alpha>0\) and \(P_1\), then \(\alpha\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(P_1,P_2\) meet at \(x=\pm3\): area \(=\int_{-3}^{3}(27-3x^2)\,dx=108\).
\(y=\alpha x\) and \(P_1\) meet at \(x=0,\tfrac\alpha4\): area \(=\int_0^{\alpha/4}(\alpha x-4x^2)\,dx=\tfrac{\alpha^3}{96}\).
\(108=6\cdot\tfrac{\alpha^3}{96}\Rightarrow\alpha^3=1728\Rightarrow\alpha=12\).

Let \([\cdot]\) denote the greatest integer function. Then \(\displaystyle\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}\left(\frac{12(3+[x])}{3+[\sin x]+[\cos x]}\right)dx\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
On \(\left(-\tfrac\pi2,-1\right)\): \([x]=-2\), \([\sin x]=-1\), \([\cos x]=0\): integrand \(6\).
On \((-1,0)\): \([x]=-1\), \([\sin x]=-1\): integrand \(12\). On \((0,1)\): all brackets \(0\): integrand \(12\). On \(\left(1,\tfrac\pi2\right)\): \([x]=1\): integrand \(16\).
Total \(=6\left(\tfrac\pi2-1\right)+12+12+16\left(\tfrac\pi2-1\right)=11\pi+2\).

The value of \(\displaystyle\int_0^{20\pi}(\sin^4x+\cos^4x)\,dx\) is equal to:
questions.sol: \(\sin^4x+\cos^4x=\tfrac34+\tfrac14\cos4x\); the cosine integrates to \(0\) over whole periods. Integral \(=\tfrac34\cdot20\pi=15\pi\).

If the area of the region bounded by \(16x^2-9y^2=144\) and \(8x-3y=24\) is \(A\), then \(3(A+6\log_e(3))\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
The line meets the hyperbola at \((3,0)\) and \(\left(5,\tfrac{16}{3}\right)\), and lies to the right of the arc between them.
\(A=\displaystyle\int_0^{16/3}\left(\frac{3y+24}{8}-3\sqrt{1+\frac{y^2}{16}}\right)dy=\frac{64}{3}-\left(\frac{40}{3}+6\ln3\right)=8-6\ln3\).
\(3(A+6\ln3)=24\).

questions.q: The area of the region \(\{(x,y):y\le\pi-|x|,\ y\le|x\sin x|,\ y\ge0\}\) is:
questions.sol:
The region is symmetric in \(x\). On \([0,\pi]\) the curves \(x\sin x\) and \(\pi-x\) meet at \(x=\tfrac\pi2\), with \(x\sin x\) lower before it and \(\pi-x\) lower after it.
Area \(=2\left[\int_0^{\pi/2}x\sin x\,dx+\int_{\pi/2}^\pi(\pi-x)\,dx\right]=2\left[1+\tfrac{\pi^2}{8}\right]=2+\tfrac{\pi^2}{4}\).

questions.q: Let \(\displaystyle\int_{-2}^{2}\left(|\sin x|+[x\sin x]\right)dx=2(3-\cos2)+\beta\), where \([\cdot]\) is the greatest integer function. Then \(\beta\sin\left(\dfrac\beta2\right)\) equals:
questions.sol:
\(\int_{-2}^2|\sin x|\,dx=2(1-\cos2)\). The function \(x\sin x\) is even, increases on \([0,2]\) from \(0\) to \(2\sin2<2\); let \(x_0\in(0,2)\) satisfy \(x_0\sin x_0=1\).
\(\int_{-2}^2[x\sin x]\,dx=2(2-x_0)\). Total \(=2(3-\cos2)-2x_0\), so \(\beta=-2x_0\).
\(\beta\sin\tfrac\beta2=(-2x_0)\sin(-x_0)=2x_0\sin x_0=2\).

Let \(f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}\) be a function such that \(f(x)+3f\left(\dfrac\pi2-x\right)=\sin x\), \(x\in\mathbb{R}\). Let the maximum value of \(f\) on \(\mathbb{R}\) be \(\alpha\). If the area of the region bounded by the curves \(g(x)=x^2\) and \(h(x)=\beta x^3\), \(\beta>0\), is \(\alpha^2\), then \(30\beta^3\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
Also \(f\left(\tfrac\pi2-x\right)+3f(x)=\cos x\), so \(8f(x)=3\cos x-\sin x\) and \(\alpha=\tfrac{\sqrt{10}}{8}\).
Area \(=\displaystyle\int_0^{1/\beta}(x^2-\beta x^3)\,dx=\frac{1}{12\beta^3}=\frac{10}{64}\Rightarrow\beta^3=\frac{8}{15}\).

questions.q: The value of the integral \(\displaystyle\int_{-\pi/4}^{\pi/4}\left(\frac{32\cos^4x}{1+e^{\sin x}}\right)dx\) is:
questions.sol:
Adding the integrand at \(x\) and \(-x\) gives \(32\cos^4x\), so \(I=\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi/4}32\cos^4x\,dx=4\int_0^{\pi/4}(3+4\cos2x+\cos4x)\,dx\).
\(I=4\left(\tfrac{3\pi}{4}+2+0\right)=3\pi+8\).

Let \(A=\begin{bmatrix}1&3&-1\\2&1&\alpha\\0&1&-1\end{bmatrix}\) be a singular matrix. Let \(f(x)=\displaystyle\int_0^x(t^2+2t+3)\,dt\), \(x\in[1,\alpha]\). If \(M\) and \(m\) are respectively the maximum and the minimum values of \(f\) in \([1,\alpha]\), then \(3(M-m)\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\det A=3-\alpha=0\Rightarrow\alpha=3\). The integrand is positive, so \(f\) is increasing.
\(M=f(3)=27\), \(m=f(1)=\tfrac{13}{3}\); \(3(M-m)=81-13=68\).

The value of the integral \(\displaystyle\int_{-1}^{1}\left(\frac{x^3+|x|+1}{x^2+2|x|+1}\right)dx\) is equal to:
questions.sol: The \(x^3\) part is odd and integrates to \(0\). The rest is even: \(2\displaystyle\int_0^1\frac{x+1}{(x+1)^2}dx=2\ln2\).

questions.q: The value of the integral \(\displaystyle\int_0^2\frac{\sqrt{x(x^2+x+1)}}{\left(\sqrt{x+1}\right)\left(\sqrt{x^4+x^2+1}\right)}dx\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(x^4+x^2+1=(x^2+x+1)(x^2-x+1)\) and \((x+1)(x^2-x+1)=x^3+1\), so the integrand is \(\dfrac{\sqrt x}{\sqrt{x^3+1}}\).
Put \(t=x^{3/2}\), \(dt=\tfrac32\sqrt x\,dx\): \(\dfrac23\displaystyle\int_0^{2\sqrt2}\frac{dt}{\sqrt{1+t^2}}=\frac23\ln\left(2\sqrt2+3\right)\).

questions.q: Let \(f:(1,\infty)\to\mathbb{R}\) be a function defined as \(f(x)=\dfrac{x-1}{x+1}\). Let \(f^{i+1}(x)=f\left(f^i(x)\right)\), \(i=1,2,\dots,25\), where \(f^1(x)=f(x)\). If \(g(x)+f^{26}(x)=0\), \(x\in(1,\infty)\), then the area of the region bounded by the curves \(y=g(x)\), \(2y=2x-3\), \(y=0\) and \(x=4\) is:
questions.sol:
\(f^2(x)=-\tfrac1x\), so \(f^4(x)=x\) and \(f^{26}=f^2\). Hence \(g(x)=\tfrac1x\).
\(y=\tfrac1x\) meets \(y=x-\tfrac32\) at \(x=2\); the line meets \(y=0\) at \(x=\tfrac32\).
Area \(=\displaystyle\int_{3/2}^2\left(x-\tfrac32\right)dx+\int_2^4\frac{dx}{x}=\frac18+\ln2\).

questions.q: Let \(f(x)=\begin{cases}\dfrac13, & x\le\dfrac\pi2\\[6pt]\dfrac{b(1-\sin x)}{(\pi-2x)^2}, & x>\dfrac\pi2\end{cases}\). If \(f\) is continuous at \(x=\dfrac\pi2\), then the value of \(\displaystyle\int_0^{3b-6}\left|x^2+2x-3\right|dx\) is:
If \(\displaystyle\int_{\pi/6}^{\pi/4}\left(\cot\left(x-\frac\pi3\right)\cot\left(x+\frac\pi3\right)+1\right)dx=\alpha\log_e(\sqrt3-1)\), then \(9\alpha^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
From \(\cot(A-B)=\dfrac{\cot A\cot B+1}{\cot B-\cot A}\) with \(A=x+\tfrac\pi3\), \(B=x-\tfrac\pi3\): integrand \(=-\dfrac1{\sqrt3}\left[\cot\left(x-\tfrac\pi3\right)-\cot\left(x+\tfrac\pi3\right)\right]\).
Integral \(=-\dfrac1{\sqrt3}\left[\ln\left|\dfrac{\sin(x-\pi/3)}{\sin(x+\pi/3)}\right|\right]_{\pi/6}^{\pi/4}=-\dfrac1{\sqrt3}\ln\left(2\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt3-1}{\sqrt3+1}\right)=-\dfrac{2}{\sqrt3}\ln(\sqrt3-1)\).
\(\alpha=-\tfrac2{\sqrt3}\), \(9\alpha^2=12\).
